issue_title: [Feature] 添加 Todo 复制/克隆方法 copy()

implementation.changes_summary: Added copy() method to Todo class that creates a new Todo instance with the same text and done status, but with new timestamps and a configurable id (defaults to 0).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: todo.copy() returns new Todo instance with same text/done
Can optionally pass new id parameter

test_plan.test: copy() preserves text and done status
Modifying copy does not affect original
copy() preserves done state for both True/False

ruff_check.command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/todo.py tests/test_issue_6341_todo_copy.py

risks_limitations: Minimal change with no backward compatibility concerns. The new id defaults to 0 which is consistent with the pattern of creating new todos that need to be assigned proper ids by the storage layer.
